recent.text: Final: Hawks 113, Bucks 106 McCollum: 20 pts, 4 stl Okongwu: 16 pts, 11 reb Alexander-Walker: 20 pts Kispert: 14 pts
recent.author: Kevin Chouinard

recent.text: Hawks 2-7 from the field with 3 turnovers in the last 5 minutes of the game. But the two buckets came from McCollum, including a 10-footer to put ATL up 5 with 17 seconds left.
recent.author: Brad Rowland

recent.text: CJ McCollum hits a one-legged step-back middie to put the Hawks up 111-106 with 17 seconds to play. The Bucks call a timeout.
recent.author: Lauren L. Williams

recent.text: Jalen Johnson clearly fouled on the drive shoved toward the baseline. I guess he has to flop to sell it or something because he had no chance to do anything but to try to heave the ball to the backcourt for a teammate.
recent.author: Kevin Chouinard

recent.text: Daniels re-enters with 5.5 minutes left. Barring overtime, he will finish with less than 27 minutes played.
recent.author: Brad Rowland
recent.quoted_text: Not that Quin has any interest in explaining any rotation decision, but I'm utterly baffled by Wiggins over Dyson right now.

recent.text: Not that Quin has any interest in explaining any rotation decision, but I'm utterly baffled by Wiggins over Dyson right now.
recent.author: Brad Rowland

recent.text: Both have played relatively significant minutes, but Dort has 2 turnovers and Wiggins has 4, which can't happen.
recent.author: Kevin Chouinard

recent.text: Oooof, brutal for Zuby Ejiofor with b2b fouls. One on a Gary Trent Jr. 3 to make a 4-pt play. Trent missed the FT and the Hawks don't get the rebound and then Ejiofor fouled Kel'el Ware. He got subbed out for Onyeka Okongwu.
recent.author: Lauren L. Williams

recent.text: ATL gave up 4 points on the first possession of the fourth quarter. Zuby committed 2 fouls and that got Okongwu off the bench quickly.
recent.author: Brad Rowland
recent.quoted_text: The Hawks will take a 7-point lead to the 4th quarter in Milwaukee. Got out-shot from 3 (again) in Q3 but won the margins to extend the advantage.

recent.text: It is not difficult to have faith in a Ejiofor-Kispert-Daniels bench trio regardless of how you would fill out the other two spots.
recent.author: Kevin Chouinard

recent.text: 12-2 run for the Bucks and it's a 3-point game again. 2 (very) rough turnovers from Aaron Wiggins helped to fuel it.
recent.author: Brad Rowland

recent.quoted_text: Heading into Sunday's game, Jalen Johnson is 28 for 98 on all shot attempts outside of 4 feet. That is 28.6%. For reference, he shot 39.5% on those shots last season. Massive difference that is holding back his efficiency (and the team's).
